segments.title: Explore your IFC model
segments.description: See the building, model hierarchy, and connected data in one workspace.

segments.title: Find objects through conversation
segments.description: Ask about an element and move from the full building to a focused view.

segments.title: Inspect the selected object
segments.description: Review object identity, IFC class, dimensions, and available properties.

segments.title: Keep the conversation connected
segments.description: Ask follow-up questions while the selected object stays in view.

segments.title: Compare model data with your standard
segments.description: Use the linked UniFormat workbook to support classification review.

segments.title: Review the suggested mapping
segments.description: Inspect classification evidence and check the suggestion before applying changes.
